newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK job add takes political correctness to extremes.
newsitem.headline: HK job add takes political correctness to extremes.

text.p: Hong Kong could be the answer for androgynous, stateless ethnic minorities in search of work. They don't even need experience.
An employer advertising for staff took political correctness to extremes in an effort to conform with the territory's new law against sexual and ethnic discrimination.
"Sex, experience and nationality not essential," read the advertisement by a company in Hong Kong's Kowloon commercial district, the South China Morning Post newspaper said on Friday.

Hong Kong introduced an anti-discrimination, equal opportunities law last September. It includes a ban on discrimination in job advertisements covering concepts such as gender, marital status or disability.
